title: Increasing Repulsion Gain
statement: Increasing the repulsion gain will make the robot more responsive to nearby obstacles, reducing the likelihood of collisions.
mechanism: The repulsion gain controls how strongly the robot reacts to obstacles in its path, which can be adjusted to increase or decrease the avoidance response.
